results.question: Which pianos need repair, and where are they?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, r.room_number, b.name AS building_name
FROM piano p
JOIN room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN building b ON r.building_id = b.building_id
WHERE p.status = 'needs repair';
results.answer: The pianos that need repair are a Yamaha U1 located in room C-302 of the Harris Fine Arts Center and a Baldwin Hamilton located in the Lobby of the Wilkinson Student Center.

results.question: Which pianos have never been tuned?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, p.serial_number
FROM piano p
LEFT JOIN tuning t ON p.piano_id = t.piano_id
WHERE t.tuning_id IS NULL;
results.answer: The pianos that have never been tuned are a Yamaha P-125 with serial number YM-D77120, a Steinway & Sons Model M with serial number ST-071122, and a Roland FP-30X with serial number RL-D55671.

results.question: Who tuned the Steinway in the concert hall most recently?
results.sql:
SELECT t.name AS technician_name, p.brand AS piano_brand, r.room_type, tu.tuning_date
FROM tuning tu
JOIN piano p ON tu.piano_id = p.piano_id
JOIN room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN technician t ON tu.technician_id = t.technician_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Steinway' AND r.room_type = 'concert hall'
ORDER BY tu.tuning_date DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: Which technicians are not certified, and which pianos did they tune?
results.sql:
SELECT t.name AS technician_name, p.brand AS piano_brand, p.model AS piano_model
FROM technician t
JOIN tuning tu ON t.technician_id = tu.technician_id
JOIN piano p ON tu.piano_id = p.piano_id
WHERE t.is_certified = 0;
results.answer: The technician who is not certified is Tom Alvarez. He tuned the following pianos: a Baldwin Hamilton, a Young Chang G-157, and a Baldwin Acrosonic.

results.question: Which students have reported more than one repair request?
results.sql:
SELECT s.student_id, s.name, COUNT(rr.request_id) AS request_count
FROM student s
JOIN repair_request rr ON s.student_id = rr.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(rr.request_id) > 1;

results.question: How many pianos are in each building?
results.sql:
SELECT b.name AS building_name, COUNT(p.piano_id) AS piano_count
FROM building b
LEFT JOIN room r ON b.building_id = r.building_id
LEFT JOIN piano p ON r.room_id = p.room_id
GROUP BY b.building_id, b.name;
results.answer: The number of pianos in each building is as follows: Harris Fine Arts Center has 6 pianos, Wilkinson Student Center has 2 pianos, Harold B. Lee Library has 1 piano, Joseph Smith Building has 2 pianos, and Brimhall Building has 2 pianos.

results.question: Which pianos haven't been tuned in the last 6 months?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, p.serial_number
FROM piano p
LEFT JOIN tuning t ON p.piano_id = t.piano_id AND t.tuning_date >= date('2026-10-12', '-6 months')
WHERE t.tuning_id IS NULL;

results.question: Which students have reserved a piano that currently needs repair?
results.sql:
SELECT s.student_id, s.name, p.piano_id, p.brand, p.model
FROM reservation r
JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN piano p ON r.piano_id = p.piano_id
WHERE p.status = 'needs repair';
results.answer: Ben Okafor has reserved a Yamaha U1 piano that currently needs repair.

results.question: Which piano has the most open repair requests?
results.sql:
SELECT p.brand, p.model, COUNT(rr.request_id) AS open_requests
FROM piano p
JOIN repair_request rr ON p.piano_id = rr.piano_id
WHERE rr.status = 'open'
GROUP BY p.piano_id
ORDER BY open_requests DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: The piano with the most open repair requests is a Young Chang G-157, with 1 open request.

results.question: Can I reserve a piano in the Brimhall Building?
results.sql:
SELECT p.piano_id, r.room_number, b.name AS building_name
FROM piano p
JOIN room r ON p.room_id = r.room_id
JOIN building b ON r.building_id = b.building_id
WHERE b.name = 'Brimhall Building' AND p.status = 'active'
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM reservation res
    WHERE res.piano_id = p.piano_id
    AND (
        (res.start_time < '2026-10-12 23:59:59' AND res.end_time > '2026-10-12 00:00:00')
    )
);
results.answer: Yes, you can reserve a piano in the Brimhall Building. There is an active piano available in room 120.

results.question: Which pianos are in storage?
results.answer: The only piano in storage is a Steinway & Sons Model M baby grand, with serial number ST-071122, made in 1989, and it is currently retired.
